item.title: Billboard’s Music Industry Events Calendar
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest update from the music industry. If you're looking for a one-stop-shop to stay on top of all the major music events, you're in luck. Billboard Pro has just launched a comprehensive music industry events calendar, featuring conferences, festivals, networking mixers, and more, from around the world.
From now until early 2028, you can find key events listed, including the Grammy Awards, taking place on February 7th, 2027, in Los Angeles. Whether you're an industry pro or just looking to stay in the know, this calendar is the perfect resource for you.
And, if you have an event you'd like to see listed, it's easy to get in touch. Just email joe.maimone@billboard.com for more information.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for now. Stay tuned for more updates from the music industry, and don't forget to check out Billboard Pro's new events calendar for all the latest happenings."
